_meta.survivorship: The universe is current SEC registrants only. A delisted company has no ticker and does not appear in the source file at all, so every multi-year figure on this page is conditioned on the company having survived to 2026-08-11. The exit rate is not merely unmeasured here, it is unmeasurable from free bulk sources — which is the same survivorship bias both source books are built on.
